sent_bad: Note: this is listed under the 12–18 month section and is "easy for toddlers ages 12 months and older to grab," so it's not yet age-appropriate for your 11-month-old. (doc.txt)
Durability: The NUK hard spout cup is the only one with an explicit durability claim — "a 100 percent spill-proof, leak-proof, break-proof guarantee" (doc.txt) — but it's for 12 months and older.
The ZoLi is the weakest on durability: its straw "can be bitten through" and the cup "can also leak if the straw becomes damaged from biting or normal wear and tear" (doc.txt).
Travel without spills: The NUK hard spout cup is "100 percent spill-proof, leak-proof" but "doesn't fit easily into standard cup holders or diaper bag pockets" (doc.txt).
